players.product: WhatsMiner bitcoin mining machines (immersion miners, manufactured in the United States for Riot)

connects_to.relationship: Immersion bitcoin miners supplied to Riot under a long-term master purchase and sales agreement

contracts.signal: Riot's 10-K: long-term master purchase and sales agreement dated June 23, 2023, as amended, with MicroBT Electronics Technology Co., LTD (through its manufacturing affiliate SuperAcme Technology (Hong Kong) Limited) to secure the long-term supply of immersion miners, all manufactured in the United States; MicroBT agreed to give Riot ready access to its newest and most powerful miners at their most competitive prices. Through December 31, 2025 Riot executed purchase orders for miners with a total hash rate of 49.2 EH/s for approximately $779.5 million; deliveries began in the fourth quarter of 2023 in monthly batches and all miners under current purchase orders are expected to be received by the second quarter of 2026; Riot holds options to buy more miners through December 31, 2027. Riot deploys MicroBT WhatsMiner type miners.
contracts.units: miners with a total hash rate of 49.2 EH/s (purchase orders through December 31, 2025)

players.product: Antminer bitcoin mining machines (S21, S21 Pro, S21 Hydro, T21; U3S21EXPH direct-to-chip liquid-cooled servers)

contracts.signal: Riot's 10-K: 'We currently deploy Bitmain Technologies Limited (Bitmain) Antminer, and MicroBT WhatsMiner type miners'; a substantial portion of its fleet relies on machines produced by a limited number of manufacturers, and defects or failures in miners supplied by Bitmain, MicroBT or other manufacturers could materially affect it.
